components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single strongest action on a task surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 48px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 24px; color: var(--color-on-accent); background: var(--color-mineral-teal); font: 650 14px/1.45 "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-mineral-teal-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--color-mineral-teal-active); transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A persistent label with a calm, high-contrast field.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: var(--color-ink-navy); font: 650 14px/1.45 "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height: 48px; border: 1px solid var(--color-blueprint-line); border-radius: 8px; padding: 0 16px; color: var(--color-ink-navy); background: var(--color-atlas-paper); font: 400 16px/1.6 "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: var(--color-muted-slate); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 3px; border-color: var(--color-mineral-teal); }

components.name: Form Error
components.description: A form-level failure that never identifies which credential was wrong.
components.html: We couldn't sign you in with those credentials. Check your details and try again.
components.css: .ds-form-error { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 20px 1fr; gap: 12px; align-items: start; border: 1px solid var(--color-refusal-red); border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 16px; color: var(--color-refusal-red); background: var(--color-refusal-surface); font: 400 14px/1.45 "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-form-error svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; }

components.name: Product Identity
components.description: Compact product identification for entry and shell surfaces.
components.html: ConnectSphere
components.css: .ds-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; color: var(--color-ink-navy); font: 700 18px/1.2 "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-brand svg { width: 32px; height: 32px; fill: none; stroke: var(--color-mineral-teal); stroke-width: 1.8; } .ds-brand circle { fill: var(--color-mineral-teal); stroke: none; }

narrative.overview: ConnectSphere feels like a well-made operational map: composed at first glance, precise under inspection, and useful while several people coordinate time-sensitive work. The interface is light, flat, and orderly at rest. Structure comes from a self-adjusting grid, semantic spacing, tonal surfaces, and fine dividers.
keyCharacteristics: Clear roles, statuses, ownership, and next actions
Dense when useful, spacious when comprehension needs it
Familiar controls with complete accessible states

rules.name: The Ten Percent Rule
rules.body: Mineral Teal occupies no more than ten percent of an operational screen. Its rarity preserves meaning.

rules.name: The Status Needs Two Signals Rule
rules.body: Status is always communicated by text or icon as well as colour.

rules.name: The Tinted Canvas Rule
rules.body: Pure black and pure white are prohibited. Every neutral belongs to the Atlas family.

rules.name: The One Working Voice Rule
rules.body: One sans family carries the product. Display faces, decorative italics, and monospace styling are prohibited in ordinary interface copy.

rules.name: The Hierarchy Before Colour Rule
rules.body: Size, weight, and spacing establish reading order before accent colour is introduced.

rules.name: The Atlas Lies Flat Rule
rules.body: Permanent page regions do not float. If every surface casts a shadow, the hierarchy has failed.

rules.name: The State Motion Rule
rules.body: State transitions use the 160ms ease-out token. Reduced-motion preferences collapse them to effectively immediate feedback.

dos: Do make the active role, owner, state, and next action visible wherever they affect a decision.
Do use the documented 4px spacing scale and the 8px standard control radius.
Do maintain WCAG 2.2 Level AA contrast and the three-pixel visible keyboard focus treatment.
Do use status text or icons alongside semantic colour.
Do let spacing, tonal surfaces, and fine full dividers organise dense information.
Do use the approved Operations Atlas background only as decorative imagery; keep interface copy and meaningful controls as semantic HTML.
donts: Don't use a colourful festival or ticket-sales aesthetic for internal operations.
Don't imitate Jira's configuration overload, visual clutter, or deeply nested settings.
Don't inherit the dense legacy-enterprise character associated with large event-management suites.
Don't use generic purple SaaS gradients, glassmorphism, neon decoration, confetti, or stock event photography as product identity.
Don't make the entire application resemble a dark developer tool or depend on keyboard-first interaction.
Don't add decorative dashboards, cards, charts, or motion that do not help a user complete a task.
Don't use coloured side-stripe borders, gradient text, nested cards, or modals as a first response to layout problems.
